x-k-fill-04.title: Dem cancel Saturday meeting?
x-k-fill-04.topic: Check claims and proof: how much to trust reported speech
x-k-fill-04.goal: Judge how reliable chains of reported speech (-대요, 들었어요) be, and change your judgment when first-hand notice show.
x-k-fill-04.material:
You join club. Three messages show for group chat.

하은: 나도 취소됐다고 들었어. 누가 그러던데.
공지(게시판, 회장): 토요일 모임은 비가 오지 않으면 예정대로 합니다.

At first, you only see di first two messages.
x-k-fill-04.thinking.0: Count how many people message pass through
x-k-fill-04.thinking.1: Separate repeated news from different sources
x-k-fill-04.thinking.2: Change judgment when better proof show
x-k-fill-04.prereq.0: Know reported speech endings -대요/-래요 (reporting wetin somebody talk)
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.prompt: Use di first two messages (지수 and 하은) as proof. Which reading best?
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.hint.0: Check who each message say di news come from.
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ask whether any speaker say she see or decide di cancellation herself.
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.o.a: Dem na two independent witnesses, so di news almost certainly true
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.r.a: Neither woman say she see am or decide am; and 하은 ‘누가’ fit be same person wey 지수 hear from.
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.o.b: 지수 get first-hand information, because 지수 name 민재 as source
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.r.b: 지수 just repeat wetin 민재 talk (민재가 그러는데); naming source no make am first-hand.
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.o.c: Both fit dey pass on same unnamed rumour, so dem no be two proofs
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.r.c: You notice say two people repeating -대/-던데 fit just dey pass on same source.
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.o.d: 하은 get first-hand information, because she write 들었어 herself
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.r.d: 들었어 mean she hear am from somebody; she no see am or decide am.
x-k-fill-04.s.s1.explain: 지수 hear am from 민재, and 하은 hear am from ‘누가’ (somebody). Dem fit be same rumour wey two people repeat; that no be two independent proofs.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.prompt: Read each new piece of information in order. After each one, choose how sure you be say dem cancel Saturday meeting.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.hint.0: After each step, ask: who really see or decide this?
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.hint.1: You fit change your answer; na that the exercise dey teach.

x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.0.after: Both messages na reported speech, and nobody wey see decision dey talk. ‘Probably’ fine; ‘sure’ too strong.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.0.r.a: Two messages feel stronger than one, but both na hearsay.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.0.o.b: Dem probably cancel am, but I wan know who decide.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.0.r.b: You believe di news and ask where e come from.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.0.o.c: I no fit tell yet: nobody talk say dem decide am.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.0.r.c: You notice say nobody wey dem name na di person wey decide.

x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.1.info: You ask 민재. E answer: ‘나는 서연이한테 '비가 많이 오면 취소될 수도 있대'라고 들었어. 확정은 아니야.’
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.1.after: Di first message say ‘cancelled (됐대).’ Di original only say ‘maybe, if it rains much (될 수도 있대).’ Every retelling make am sound stronger.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Di new message change ‘cancelled’ to ‘fit cancel am if rain plenty.’
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.1.o.b: Dem cancel am, but only if rain plenty.
x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.1.r.b: You keep wetin di new message talk and di condition.

x-k-fill-04.s.s2.st.1.r.c: You notice say di sentence become weaker as dem pass am on.
